notes: Actual results reported to the State Comptroller for the fiscal year ending 2021-12-31, not an adopted budget.
This is the latest annual report City of Mount Vernon has filed with the State Comptroller; newer years are not on file.
Covers this government only. County, school-district and special-district taxes on the same bills belong to separate governments.
Left out of money in: transfers between the government's own funds ($3,223,551).
Employee benefits ($42,035,685) are spread across departments in proportion to their size.

Political money counts PAC, business and union contributions to candidates for City of Mount Vernon offices reported to the State Board of Elections since 2022-10-01. Individual donors ($415,457 in the same period), candidates' own committees and party committees are not counted. Campaigns that raise little may not itemize, so some contributions may not appear.
Transparency practices have not been checked yet, so they are not scored.

Red flags: surveillance programs come from the EFF Atlas of Surveillance, a public database of news reports and public records, searched on 2026-10-01. Data center deals and corporate lobbying come from a hand-checked list of news reports and public records. A town with none listed may still have programs nobody has reported. Most records carry no dollar amount, so each documented program costs a quarter of the red-flag points instead of being counted as spending.

Red flags: 7 license-plate cameras are mapped inside City of Mount Vernon's borders in OpenStreetMap (3 made by Flock Safety), not counting cameras tagged as run by stores, malls, schools or state and regional agencies. Flock cameras count as a red flag whoever runs them. Other brands count only when the town is the recorded operator, since many have no operator recorded.

redFlags.label: Flock camera network
redFlags.detail: 3 Flock Safety license-plate cameras are mapped inside City of Mount Vernon's borders in OpenStreetMap. Flock cameras photograph every passing car and feed a search network shared with police agencies across the country. Who runs each camera is not recorded; cameras tagged as run by stores, malls, schools or state and regional agencies are not counted.
